purpose: Complete actual owner-demand outcomes across the whole SMS product, under read-only CAOS governance. Not a business runtime task or second scheduler.

integration.observed_failure: System audit: domain/communication.py unowned and unclassified. Remaining tests skipped. Manifest regression: NO_DEFAULT_VIDEO_FINAL invariant removed by previous edit.
integration.new_changes: Assign pure communication contract to owner of typed domain contracts; restore manifest invariant; preserve optional dataclass constructor; add construction checkpoint, references and consistency test. New exact-head CI required.

decision.problem: Repeated session drift despite product runtime recovery; no current construction-wide task map in inspected tree, historical audit head stale, previous local change missed cross-subsystem contract.

alternatives.route: Rewrite engine or duplicate CAOS/runtime ledger
alternatives.disposition: REJECT: wrong layer, risks duplicate state and loss of valid functionality.

alternatives.route: Continue independent subsystem patches or create more PRs
alternatives.disposition: REJECT: dependencies, current goal and verification drift.

alternatives.route: Single Git-versioned construction checkpoint in existing integration PR, existing canonical product entry locates it, structural tests verify coverage
alternatives.disposition: SELECT conditionally; no runtime controller or new authority. Actual owner outcomes remain the oracle.

decision.falsifier: If a new session cannot recover exact task/branch/evidence from the checkpoint, or a mapped scenario/owner outcome fails, reopen the relevant ancestor; do not add another parallel plan.
decision.rollback: Revert this commit on integration branch if necessary; main untouched. Never erase earlier evidence.

protocol.resume: Read current PR head, then this checkpoint at that head, exact-head CI, and relevant source; owner correction outranks checkpoint. If branch diverges or another task owner changed it, reconcile before writing. Do not use most recent timestamp alone.
protocol.selection: Execute all lawful ready obligations by causal priority, first recover goal and restore broken baseline; parallelize independent evidence where useful. Do not narrow whole goal to last changed subsystem. Revisit upstream decisions when contradicted.
protocol.checkpoint: In the same logical change, update affected obligations, evidence, blocker and next action; Git history preserves previous observations. Never store raw private goals or secrets in repository. Never claim external actions occurred without readback.
protocol.acceptance: A task may be VERIFIED only with explicit exact-version evidence of its own acceptance and all dependencies VERIFIED; CI proves code checks only. External permissions, independently reviewed actual outputs and native client selection stay unknown until proven.
protocol.stop: All obligations VERIFIED with actual owner outcome; otherwise retain open/blocked tasks and concrete next action. No background work claim.

tasks.acceptance: System audit, topology, full tests and all CLI smoke checks pass on actual integration head; failures investigated, not suppressed.
tasks.next_action: Inspect new exact-head CI jobs; if a gate fails, investigate first causal error and dependent contracts. Do not mark complete on old-head CI.

tasks.goal: Recover and reconcile full owner demand, corrections and final outcome
tasks.acceptance: Private original/corrections mapped to stable obligations; distinguish unknowns and user preferences; no historical work order reactivation.
tasks.next_action: Retrieve original owner records via private source; reconcile with current entry and frozen V2. Library retrieval in this turn did not locate authoritative SMS original.

tasks.goal: Whole-architecture source mapping and adversarial review
tasks.acceptance: Every current subsystem, contract, interface, scenario and forbidden effect traced to exact code/tests; conflicting architecture assumptions resolved; independent conceptual review recorded.
tasks.next_action: Reconcile the 35 frozen scenarios with current candidate head; review system topology and cross-boundary calls before choosing deeper changes.

tasks.goal: Demand admission, direct/durable continuity and execution invariants
tasks.acceptance: Owner revision, resume, independent tasks, explicit scope and retired-project negative cases work; direct conversational requests require no artificial project; no stale effect.
tasks.next_action: Trace demand correction authenticity, decision bindings, invalidation, scope isolation and actual owner-task readback. Preserve single ledger.

tasks.goal: Source understanding, evidence, knowledge and rights
tasks.acceptance: Source truth, semantic understanding, lineage, rights, scoped CRUD and independent method replays proven by actual evidence; stale claims cannot authorize effects.
tasks.next_action: Inventory current source interfaces; verify actual search/inspection capabilities and method provenance, test source replacement and scoped CRUD.

tasks.acceptance: Actual natural-language short and long copy, multilingual variants and nonrepeating packaging meet explicit audience/owner intent; no invented claims; professional review.
tasks.next_action: Audit demand routing across all craft groups (not only editorial); replay authentic short, article and platform requests with actual outputs and independent critique.

tasks.acceptance: Actual visual briefs and outputs satisfy intent, hierarchy, licensed fonts, aspect and preparation-only scope; only current approved IPOS canon is consumed; dependency-specific revocation verified.
tasks.next_action: Compare actual available visual tool operations and approved IPOS bundles; review multi-aspect and no-generation contracts; run independent artifact review.

tasks.acceptance: Actual original-video and transformation results with correct full-duration/audio preservation, requested scope, visual quality and media QA; real files, exact digests.
tasks.next_action: Inspect transform limitations and provider contracts; test eligible packet-copy, edit, enhancement and original motion against separate oracles.

tasks.goal: Growth, commerce, capability and effect boundaries
tasks.acceptance: Growth/commercial advice uses actual evidence; unavailable and unapproved provider/paid/posting routes fail closed; no performance claims without measurement.
tasks.next_action: Map account/growth/commercial cases beyond frozen matrix; verify capability handshakes without paid or posting side effects.

tasks.goal: Independent typed assurance and architecture acceptance
tasks.acceptance: Every scenario has current positive and forbidden-effect evidence, independently reviewed applicable real outputs; reviewer independence and trust proven where required; native selection evidence separately identified.
tasks.next_action: Register no unverified reviewer; obtain applicable independent assessment and exact input/output receipts; reopen upstream failures. Blocked for required high-assurance executions until a trusted executor is evaluated.
tasks.blocker: Trusted high-assurance registry is empty; native CAOS selection not tested.

tasks.acceptance: All required obligations and acceptance scenarios independently satisfied or explicitly owner-approved scope change; exact-head CI; clean rollback, repeatable entry/resume and owner-facing handoff. No automatic merge or publish.
tasks.next_action: Recheck latest head and all open obligations, compare against owner goal; request only actual missing permissions if needed. Keep PR draft until gates pass.
